summary: OpenAI's Chief Global Affairs Officer publishes a policy position advocating for state-level AI safety legislation to converge into a national US framework and for federal testing standards for frontier models on cyber capability.

practices.reason: The document describes a forthcoming federal framework for testing capable models on cyber risk, which an engineering team building safety evaluation practice would want to track even though no method is disclosed.
practices.quote: the Trump Administration continues to work with technical and national security experts on a framework for US government testing of the most capable AI models on cyber. That framework will establish testing standards, timelines, and processes.
